requirements.text: Our client is seeking a Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience to join a fast-growing, early-stage AI company as a core member of its engineering team.
Python and TypeScript are core requirements. AWS experience is preferred, but experience with other cloud platforms may be transferable.
Experience working at a startup with real customers, not only in a pre-product or pre-revenue environment.
Proven experience personally building and shipping customer-facing products or major features end-to-end.
Strong systems-design and code-architecture skills.
Strong frontend and UI judgment, including the ability to build polished customer-facing interfaces.
Experience building enterprise-facing dashboards or workflows.
A CS or technical degree from a top-30 university, or an exceptional technical project record that clearly demonstrates comparable ability.
Evidence of independently building meaningful technical projects, such as strong side projects, an active GitHub portfolio, founding experience, or comparable work.
Ability to operate across frontend and backend development rather than specializing exclusively in one area.
High ownership, resourcefulness, and comfort working with ambiguity.
Willingness to work on-site in San Francisco 5 days per week.
Comfort working in an intense early-stage startup environment with approximately 12-hour workdays and occasional weekend work.
Founding engineer, early engineer, or similarly high-ownership startup experience.
Experience solving meaningful production, scaling, or systems-design problems.
Experience building customer-facing enterprise products, dashboards, or workflows.
Experience with AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, or forward deployed engineering.
Strong independent projects that demonstrate technical depth and a genuine interest in building.
Experience working directly with founders, customers, or other business stakeholders.
Python and TypeScript are core requirements. AWS experience is preferred, but experience with other cloud platforms may be transferable.
